name: Ward Versus Cathayans (Thaumaturgy, Level Three Ritual)

system.description:
Modeled after Ward Versus Ghouls, this ritual protects an object or area against Kuei-jin. The caster mixes a half-pint of Cathayan blood with one of her own blood points and pours the mixture over the object or marks the boundary of the affected area while reciting the incantation; the ritual takes about 15 minutes assuming the blood is already prepared.

System: Any Kuei-jin who passes through or touches a warded area suffers three dice of lethal damage every turn. The Kuei-jin must spend a Willpower point to continue touching the object or remain in the area, and must check for wave soul each turn she does so; entering wave soul forces her to flee the warded area as quickly as possible.
system.source: San Francisco by Night, Chapter Six: Storytelling San Francisco
system.bloodCost: Half-pint of Kuei-jin blood plus one Blood Trait of the caster's own vitae
